name: 3Dgenius
summary: Amazon brand of small-spool silk PLA (dual, triple colour, rainbow, gradient) and matte rainbow PLA, mostly 250 g and 500 g spools and multi-packs at about $20-46/kg, with a few 1 kg spools at about $22/kg. Sold by a Shenzhen seller whose storefront is named JMLocks; the extruder is unknown.

product_lines.name: PLA Silk Dual / Triple Color, Rainbow, Gradient
product_lines.notes: Mostly 250 g and 500 g spools ($20-46/kg) and 4-12 spool mini packs; one 1 kg tri-colour spool at $21.99.

additional_notes: Legal entity: shen zhen shi jin ma suo ye you xian gong si (rendering, uncertain: Shenzhen Jinmasuoye Co., Ltd., possibly 'Jinma Lock Industry', consistent with the storefront name 'JMLocks'), Fuhai Subdistrict, Bao'an District, Shenzhen, Guangdong; Amazon seller 'JMLocks' (id A1KJ9E6OZ7W0FC), read 2026-11-06. The listing's Manufacturer field reads '3Dgenius'. Store is Amazon only; no brand website was identified. The storefront name and the likely reading of the Business Name point to a lock business, so 3Dgenius filament is presumably bought in; extruder unknown. Price tier set to mid: the per-kg price is high only because most spools are 250-500 g.

provenance.conflicts: The Business Name is spaced pinyin and the 'lock industry' reading is an inference from the storefront name 'JMLocks', not a printed English name. Extruder unknown.
